title: SAM's Ankita Kumar joins Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas as Partner focusing on Aviation, Aerospace and Defence sectors
description: Ankita Kumar has joined Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas as a Partner with her team in the Corporate Practice focusing on Aviation, Aerospace, and Defence sectors at the New Delhi office. Kumar is a 2008 alumna of NALSAR, Hyderabad.She advises clients across the civil and general aviation, advanced air mobility, NewSpace and defence sectors on a broad range of regulatory, transactional and strategic matters, including several high-value and cross-border mandates.
